name: punchwall-free-aim-combat-polish
description: Validate free-aim punching, half-radius cubic excavation, single-channel impact audio, forceful debris, coin-only wall rewards, clean forest map, hidden block HP HUD, and safe HUD number bounds.

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local f=root["Depth Blocks"] local first=f:GetChildren()[1] local buildings,overlays,curatedSkyline=0,0,0 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then if d:GetAttribute("TextureStyle")=="BuildingFacadeWindows" or d:GetAttribute("VisualRole")=="DistantSkyline" then buildings+=1 end if d:GetAttribute("VisualRole")=="CombatPlazaPaver" or d.Name=="City Lane Paint" or string.find(d.Name,"Checkpoint") then overlays+=1 end end end local curated=workspace:FindFirstChild("CuratedVisualAssets") if curated then for _,v in ipairs(curated:GetChildren()) do if string.find(v.Name,"Skyline") or string.find(v.Name,"City Landmark") then curatedSkyline+=1 end end end return H:JSONEncode({count=#f:GetChildren(),size=tostring(first.Size),fieldCount=root:GetAttribute("DepthBlockCount"),radius=root:GetAttribute("PunchRadius"),mode=root:GetAttribute("PunchTargetMode"),buildings=buildings,curatedSkyline=curatedSkyline,overlays=overlays})

steps.label: cubic field and clean forest environment

args.code:
do
 local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player, world, storage)
  assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','fixture requires an ephemeral Studio world')
  assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'world allows live profile access')
  assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'ServerStorage opts into live data')
  assert(player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture requires a ready nonwritable ephemeral player')
  return true
 end
 assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'combat QA is Studio-only')
 local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'combat QA requires exactly one isolated player')
 verifyEphemeralSeed(players[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'))
end
local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=15,FistMastery=1,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local hrp=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart hrp.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,-40)) local before=hrp.CFrame.LookVector local r=c:Invoke("PunchRadius") local after=hrp.CFrame.LookVector local debris=workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Physics Debris"]:GetChildren() local minSpeed=math.huge for _,d in ipairs(debris) do minSpeed=math.min(minSpeed,d:GetAttribute("InitialForwardSpeed") or 0) end return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,hits=r.hitCount,lookDelta=(before-after).Magnitude,power=r.Power,mastery=r.FistMastery,coins=r.Coins,broken=r.BrokenDepthBlocks,fragments=#debris,minSpeed=minSpeed})

steps.label: free aim keeps facing and wall rewards coins only

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local minVelocity,minOffset=math.huge,math.huge for _,d in ipairs(workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Physics Debris"]:GetChildren()) do minVelocity=math.min(minVelocity,d:GetAttribute("InitialForwardSpeed") or 0) minOffset=math.min(minOffset,d:GetAttribute("SpawnFrontOffset") or 0) end return H:JSONEncode({minForwardVelocity=minVelocity,minFrontOffset=minOffset})

steps.label: debris starts outside the wall and bursts toward open space

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local gui=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local bridge=gui.PunchWallClientAutomation return H:JSONEncode({third=bridge:Invoke("Punch"),blocked=gui:GetAttribute("PunchActionCooldownBlocked"),motions=gui:GetAttribute("CharacterPunchCount") or 0,interval=gui:GetAttribute("PunchAttackInterval")})

steps.label: animation follows the one-second action cooldown

args.code:
local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local gui=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local highlights=0 for _,d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("Highlight") then highlights+=1 end end local punchChannels=0 local music for _,d in ipairs(game:GetService("SoundService"):GetChildren()) do if d:IsA("Sound") then if d.Name=="Punch Impact Channel" then punchChannels+=1 end if d.Name=="Hero Forest Music" then music=d end end end local hud=gui.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local power=hud:FindFirstChild("PowerValue",true) local coins=hud:FindFirstChild("CoinsValue",true) local wall=hud:FindFirstChild("DepthValue",true) local function maxSize(v) local c=v and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") return c and c.MaxTextSize or 0 end local function verifyHudValue(value, mask, maxTextSize)
 assert(value and value:IsA('TextLabel') and mask and mask:IsA('GuiObject'), 'missing live HUD value or mask')
 assert(value.Visible and value.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and value.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 and value.Text~='', 'HUD value is hidden or empty')
 local limit=value:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint')
 assert(limit and limit.MaxTextSize==maxTextSize, 'HUD text maximum drifted')
 local a,b=value.AbsolutePosition,value.AbsolutePosition+value.AbsoluteSize
 local m,z=mask.AbsolutePosition,mask.AbsolutePosition+mask.AbsoluteSize
 assert(a.X>=m.X-2 and a.Y>=m.Y-2 and b.X<=z.X+2 and b.Y<=z.Y+2, 'HUD number escaped its artwork mask')
 assert(value.TextBounds.X<=value.AbsoluteSize.X+2 and value.TextBounds.Y<=value.AbsoluteSize.Y+2, 'HUD text overflows its number area')
 return true
end
local hudSafe=verifyHudValue(power,power and power.Parent:FindFirstChild('PowerMask'),26) and verifyHudValue(coins,coins and coins.Parent:FindFirstChild('CoinsMask'),26) and verifyHudValue(wall,wall and wall.Parent:FindFirstChild('WallMask'),27)
return H:JSONEncode({highlights=highlights,targetHUD=gui.TargetWallHUD.Visible,targetEnabled=gui:GetAttribute("TargetBlockHUDEnabled"),freeAim=gui:GetAttribute("FreeAimPunch"),soundMode=gui:GetAttribute("PunchSoundMode"),punchChannels=punchChannels,musicPlaying=music and music.Playing,musicLooped=music and music.Looped,musicId=music and music.SoundId,powerMax=maxSize(power),coinsMax=maxSize(coins),wallMax=maxSize(wall),hudSafe=hudSafe,motionDuration=gui:GetAttribute("PunchAnimationDuration"),motionCount=gui:GetAttribute("CharacterPunchCount") or 0})
